messages:
sofia: I just merged #4321 (bench/rollup) and the main pipeline flipped red. Can someone grab a quick look? :eyes:
ben: on it, pinging ci logs
tara: I see the failing stage: longtail-latency-test in the smoke matrix. Quick log snippet:```
E AssertionError: tail latency 312ms > 200ms
  at tests/prefix_cache_invalidation_test.py:48
  requests to http://embedder-eu-west1 returned 502
```
ci-bot: Build 1860001234 — FAILED — longtail-latency-test (smoke)
luis: which test exactly? full name please
sofia: prefix_cache_invalidation_test::test_eviction_latency
oncall-robin: grabbing this now. starting a bisect on recent merges to main, will try a rerun of just that stage first.
ben: command to rerun I use: `./scripts/ci retry --build 1860001234 --stage longtail-latency-test`
ci-bot: Rerun queued for build 1860001234 (retry-1)
ci-bot: Retry-1 finished — FAILED — same test (seed=98765)
sofia: hmm the only thing in my PR was bumping the base image and a small http client timeout tweak. I can try reverting the image bump if we think that's suspicious.
tara: logs show a spike in request time to embedder during the test — could be a transient infra blip but it's reproducible on retry which is worrying.
luis: can we run with a fixed seed and collect per-request traces? `PYTEST_RANDOM_SEED=1234 pytest -k test_eviction_latency -q --showlocals`
oncall-robin: doing a targeted rerun with seed=1234 and tracing enabled, I'll post artifacts when ready.
amanda: @oncall-robin adding me as backup — if this stays red for >30m we'll revert the merge to avoid affecting dependent rollouts.
ci-bot: Targeted run (seed=1234) — PASS ✅
ben: interesting, flaky then. but we had two failed retries earlier. could be timing sensitive with the new base image.
sofia: rolling back the base-image bump in a patch branch now so we can test a clean compare.
oncall-robin: if the targeted run passes consistently, I'll flag the failure as flaky and mark for follow-up (ENGINFRA-2987).
luis: agree, collect traces and heap/proc stats from the failing runs, then re-open if we see a pattern.
amanda: thanks all. if we see another failure on main after rollback attempt, revert will be executed. For now marking this as "investigate, non-blocking" and assigning follow-up. :white_check_mark:
sofia: thanks — will post PR to revert the image bump and link artifacts.
ben: closing the loop for now, will watch alerts for 30m.
ci-bot: Thread closed (no new failures for 30m)
